findings.claim: Original 00412120 terrain plane resolver computes a zone-stride of 0x8004 bytes for each 128x128 uint16 plane, rather than a packed 0x8000 or the incorrectly assumed 0x10008/0x20010 strides.
findings.limitations: Describes per-plane original address arithmetic; separate zone allocation/lifetime is unresolved.

findings.claim: Original 00412300 uses 00439EF0 byte zone map and 128-cell local masks; original 0041F2B0 returned 0xffffffff for a negative X, whereas synthetic positive X=128/129 in correctly initialized adjacent zone returned unset 0x8000.
findings.limitations: Tests on synthetic map IDs 0/1 with allocator forced to success; negative Y separately supported by static branch.

findings.claim: With original 00421DF0, 00409210, 00421BE0 and original native terrain getter/setters executing, synthetic 128-cell zone boundary runs for modes 2/3/4/5 matched the corresponding single-zone results after +107 X translation; mode 3 propagated height 600 to 25 new cells, nine across X=128.
findings.limitations: Original zone-backing allocator 00411BA0 was substituted and terrain contents were synthetic; Ghidra x87 emulation cannot be assumed bit-exact.

findings.claim: An exploratory two-zone transcript that produced attenuated heights arose from a harness initialization error: zone-1 sentinel bytes were placed at wrong offsets. Correcting the stride to original 0x8004 restores the sentinel and removes the artificial attenuation.

evidence.ref: private v28 checkpoint evidence/invalid_stride_negative_control.txt and corrected native_getter_edge.txt

findings.limitations: This is a methodological falsification of a synthetic emulator setup, not retail terrain behavior.

findings.claim: With original raster and native terrain accessors, reversing a fractional diagonal cross-section yielded different occupied-cell addresses under Ghidra P-code emulation, but the result is insufficient to infer a retail directionality defect.
findings.limitations: Uninitialized FPU stack diagnostics and previously measured hardware/Ghidra x87 disagreement preclude a bit-exact retail conclusion; original editable .I76 road graph unavailable.
